_doc: Committed build-time baselines for the hard-law checker tools/check_build_time.py (canonical law: CLAUDE.md working-style item 6). Cold-equivalent measurements excluding downloads; tile records qualify only when features.textures_missing == 0 AND features.insets_fetched == 0 (a run that fetched airport elevation insets books that download time into step-1 seconds). Update via 'venv/bin/python tools/check_build_time.py --run --update-baselines <ICAO ...>' and commit alongside the change that paid for any new numbers.

CYXY.note: DEFAULT-ARM baseline (no O4_* gates set) recorded for the kill-half round (docs/specs/kill-half-spec.md §5), 2 cold-equivalent runs, foreground + exclusive, median.  MEASUREMENT CONDITION: the machine was measurably slower this session than during the 2026-08-04 overnight approval battery — phases this round cannot touch drifted with it (HECA emit 79.7-80.1 s overnight vs 81.2-90.2 s in every arm measured here) — so these numbers are CONSERVATIVE.  A same-session pre-kill control (worktree at 4d20c7c, CAND arm, warm caches) measured CYXY 35.8 / SPJC 177.15 / HECA 336.5 s, i.e. the kill round itself is not resolvable above the noise.

KCLT.note: KCLT joins the battery as the FAA fixture (docs/RULINGS.md campaign goal). DEFAULT-ARM baseline (no O4_* gates set), WITH the +35-081 regional road clip (clip_+035-0081_3537cb8d9a74) so the road feed is live -- a no-road-clip build is a different airport (1943 vs 2290 shapes). tools/check_build_time.py --run --runs 2, foreground+exclusive, median of 308.0/306.6 s (0.5% apart). OVER the 60 s per-airport budget by 5.1x -- standing fact for the owner's budget ruling, not an approval.
